Koyomi reads your calendar and never writes to it. Your events never leave your phone. The only thing that uses the internet is the weather, and only if you choose a city: its coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo.
Fonts and data used by Koyomi
Font of the 和風 theme, reduced to commonly used characters

Holidays up to 2021 come from the table published by the Cabinet Office of Japan (内閣府, 「国民の祝日」について). From 2022 on they are calculated from the current law; the equinox days are an estimate until they are officially announced.
